articles.title: Agilent Technologies (A) Expands Tumor Profiling With New Pan Heme Research Panel
articles.description:
Agilent Technologies (NYSE:A) introduced the SureSelect Cancer Research Pan Heme panel for tumor profiling in hematologic malignancies.
- The new assay is co-developed with hematology experts to support comprehensive genomic profiling in blood cancer research…
